title: New Location
content: Okay so this is the closest I can get using AI to create the scene. But within the last few months I've "unlocked" a new location that I had never dreamed of until recently and it's become a consistent location ever since. The best way to describe it is I am standing on an upper level floor of a building looking out of a big window and outside the view is of a large open field that is bordered with a forest of trees along the north and eastern border of the field with mountains in the distance. The westen side of the field has a beach shore. Now, unlike the photo, in my dreams the field is more rectangular and the beach is further in the distance- not so close up. Has anyone expected anything similar?? I'm very used to the schools and the steep bridge highway, but this new setting feels significant, at least to me!
